[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
W.T. (William Thomas) Glasgow was born the 31st of January,1838,  the first child of 
[[Glasgow-108|Elijah Glasgow]] and [[Jeans-78|Jane C Jeans]] in Henry County, Tennessee. 
The family moved to Greene (later Clay) County, Arkansas in 1854. In 1861, he enlisted in the Confederate, where he apparently was captured twice <ref> A Memorial and Biographical History of McLennan, Falls, Bell and Coryell Counties, Texas: Containing a History of this Important Section of the Great State of Texas, from the Earliest Period of Its Occupancy to the Present Time, Together with Glimpses of Its Future Prospects : Also Biographical Mention of Many of the Pioneers and Prominent Citizens of the Present Time, and Full-pa ge Portraits of Some of the Most Eminent Men of this Section, Volume 2 (Google eBook)</ref> On the 8th of January, he married Burns-18289 in Hot Spring, Arkansas. In 1870, they moved to Coryell, Texas where they settled.
